summary: {person} brings the people who will clean a new facility into the design discussion.
realLife: Seattle Parks reported developing restroom design standards addressing material life, safe operations and how easily crews can maintain the building.
gates: A design under review and an operations assessment of its upkeep.
weights: A replacement for a maintenance-heavy building makes crew experience more relevant.
inGame: needs: design version, proposed finish and an operations review or trial.

turns.pulledBy: A proposed finish takes too long to clean.
A sample passes the crew’s cleaning trial.
turns.writesBack: File the trial result with the specification.
